title: Turning late-night WhatsApp enquiries into booked consultations
summary: A medspa received most enquiries on WhatsApp and Instagram outside opening hours. We built an AI chatbot that answers from the clinic's own price list and policies, books consultations and hands over to staff when needed.
problem: The front desk was answering the same price and aftercare questions dozens of times a day, and messages that arrived after closing waited until the next morning. Bookings were copied by hand from chat into the calendar, and no-shows were high.
built: A WhatsApp Business API account and one shared inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram and the website chat
An AI chatbot trained only on the clinic's approved treatments, prices and policies, replying in English and Urdu
Consultation booking directly into GoHighLevel calendars, with deposits where required
Hand-off rules for medical questions and complaints, routed to the right staff member
Reminder and rebooking sequences to reduce no-shows
